9justin2: On Day 18, Nils Justin arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
alex.summerton: Valentin Summerton came up with a draft of replacements on Day 11. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Valentin Summerton gave Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi the last match in the trench. Button used it to light a candle so that Valentin could finish a letter.
Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses and Valentin Summerton have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Someone in N-F6 asked Valentin Summerton about Dunmarrow. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Felix "Parson" Jhydra and Valentin Summerton divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Valentin Summerton lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
Valentin Summerton heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
A bullet struck Valentin in the hip at N-F6. He could not stand, so the squad made a seat of their hands. Shot by Jonas "Rabbit" Simsnichols of the Hegemony (@simsnichols).
arshavir.ahmadifard166: Benedikt Ahmadifard arrived on Day 8 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Benedikt Ahmadifard and Silas White both swear they saw a ghost at Saint-Ash crossroads. Each says the other screamed first.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Benedikt Ahmadifard read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Silas White kept watch so that Benedikt Ahmadifard could sleep. Then Benedikt kept watch so that Silas could. Neither slept. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Benedikt Ahmadifard is number 556. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is lost. Benedikt Ahmadifard heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Benedikt Ahmadifard felt a hard tug at his hip at S-S15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Dick of the Hegemony (@dick_j0b).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Benedikt Ahmadifard is whole again, or near enough for the line.
A parcel came for Benedikt Ahmadifard that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
Bram Yma drew a map of Benedikt Ahmadifard's hometown from Benedikt's stories. Benedikt says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.
Benedikt Ahmadifard wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
The parcel's address was smudged. Benedikt Ahmadifard took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Benedikt found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
bangarang_._._: Teodor Bangarang arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-R3 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Teodor Bangarang had just lit a cigarette at R-R3 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Pavel Rvmn of the Concord (@____rvmn). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Teodor Bangarang during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Teodor Bangarang rejoined the squad at R-R3. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Teodor Bangarang helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Teodor Bangarang fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-R3. Hugo Luissantos was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Teodor Bangarang counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas was gravely wounded.

Teodor Bangarang was hit in the foot through his boot at R-R3. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Valentin Hect of the Concord (@hect_fr1). Teodor Bangarang looked over the parapet at R-R3 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Valentin Hect of the Concord (@hect_fr1).
The House of Bangarang sent Emil "Tin" Bangarang after Teodor Bangarang. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Emil "Tin" Bangarang tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

A bullet hit Emil "Tin" Bangarang in the neck at R-R3. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Bram Briton of the Concord (@martin.briton). Emil "Tin" Bangarang was hit at R-R3 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram Briton of the Concord (@martin.briton).
Otto Bangarang came to the front because his cousin Emil "Tin" Bangarang never came home. He carries his brother's pocket watch.

A bullet found Otto Bangarang at R-R3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Valentin Hect of the Concord (@hect_fr1). Otto Bangarang spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
Someone moved Otto Bangarang's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
Otto left the aid post this morning with a limp and a sack of bandages. He reached R-R3 by noon.
chibachow: The new sniper is Felix Chibachow, once a glassblower from Varenne. The corporal asked if a glassblower was any use in a trench. Felix Chibachow said he would find out.
Felix Chibachow and Walter "Mud" Xhanley cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Felix Chibachow crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at V-F3 holds again.

Shrapnel at Grey Mill. Felix Chibachow walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches. A letter from home reached Felix Chibachow before dusk. Felix Chibachow read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medic looked at Felix Chibachow's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to V-F3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Felix Chibachow found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Felix Chibachow read it while the kettle boiled.

A clear shot from V-F3. Felix Chibachow grazed Viktor "Ghost" Instavonmein and slid back down below the parapet. A letter for Felix Chibachow came all the way from home in nine days. Felix Chibachow counted them on the envelope.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Felix aimed just below it. Jakub "Rabbit" Gib was grazed.
damianbarresi: Wendel Damianbarres signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at U-F3 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Wendel Damianbarres helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Wendel Damianbarres heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
Wendel Damianbarres got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Wendel Damianbarres fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Leopold Daddy, grazed.

Wendel Damianbarres swept the enemy parapet at U-F3 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Florian Irishman was grazed. Wendel Damianbarres smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Viktor Dougdouglas came out for a cup and was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Damianbarres. Wendel Damianbarres read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Wendel Damianbarres lost a boot to the mud at U-F3. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock.
A round went through the rim of Wendel Damianbarres's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Roland "Button" Lahetta of the Concord (@cody_lahetta).
Wendel walked out of the aid post today, one arm in a sling. He was ordered to carry nothing. He carried two buckets anyway.
logancooke97: Albin Logancooke came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Albin Logancooke was hit in the foot through his boot at T-F16. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Marek Otakujake of the Concord (@otakujake_). Albin Logancooke looked over the parapet at T-F16 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Marek Otakujake of the Concord (@otakujake_).

Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke took the same post at T-F16 where Albin Logancooke stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke aimed a step ahead and fired: Viktor Dmptrk, badly wounded. A bullet went through Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke's upper arm at T-F16 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Viktor Dmptrk of the Concord (@dmptrk3).
Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
At T-F16 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke won the bet. Marek Otakujake was badly wounded.
The gun crews at T-F16 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut was badly wounded.
A bullet went through Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke's sleeve at T-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Karel Smolders of the Concord (@arno.smolders).
Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke rejoined the squad at T-F16. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Brass cases piled up around Konrad's boots at T-F16. Out of all those rounds, one found Bram Morgan, badly wounded. Konrad had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Matthias Tommaso was grazed. Machine-gun fire swept T-F16. Konrad took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch of the Concord (@paintbusch). Konrad was shot dead at T-F16 while looking over the parapet. The squad did not move for an hour.
Bram Logancooke asked about Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke on arriving at T-F16. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
michaelorlovetz: The new machine gunner gave his name as Roland Michaelorlov. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
A bullet clipped Roland Michaelorlov's helmet at N-F2 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gustav Joodiizzzlee of the Concord (@joodiizzzlee).
Roland no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
monoliths_greatest_warrior: Ivo Warrior arrived on Day 6 as a replacement. The men in R-S10 had been fighting for 5 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Ivo Warrior and Rafael Schildbroete divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
A new trench junction cost Ivo Warrior ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
A shell burst over R-S10 and Ivo Warrior went down with a leg that would not hold him. The stretcher bearers came at a run.
The stretcher Ivo Warrior lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Ivo Warrior is back at R-S10, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S10 with the rations. Ivo Warrior ate while listening to the revised orders.

Ivo Warrior caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either. Ivo Warrior got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 395. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Ivo Warrior looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Ivo Warrior helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other.

A sniper's bullet hit Ivo Warrior at R-S10. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Jakub Faulerhund of the Hegemony (@faulerhund1215). Ivo Warrior was killed at R-S10 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Jakub Faulerhund of the Hegemony (@faulerhund1215).
The papers say Florian Warrior. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Ivo Warrior's eyes. Nobody in R-S10 argues.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Florian Warrior aimed a step ahead and fired: Gustav Ethanlam, grazed.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Florian Warrior fired, and Nils Kapitancray was badly wounded. A round went through Florian Warrior's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Emil "Button" Mugginsthede of the Hegemony (@mugginsthedestroyer).

A bullet struck Florian Warrior below the ribs at R-S10. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Silas Green of the Hegemony (@femboy_green). A single shot at R-S10. Florian Warrior sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Silas Green of the Hegemony (@femboy_green).
Teodor Warrior put a bullet that missed him beside the bunk. Someone who had known Florian Warrior helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Teodor Warrior did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Teodor Warrior fired back. Quentin Lebronmygoat was badly wounded.

Teodor was carrying water up to R-S10 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Teodor did not. Shot by Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum). The sergeant at R-S10 called out a range and a spot. Teodor was the only one who hit it. Florian "Button" Raf was grazed. A bed came free in the field hospital, and Teodor was carried in at last.
pa_czucha: Emil Czucha was a coal miner in Saint-Lune until the posters went up. He came to U-F9 with a pressed cornflower, and within a day the whole squad knew that he polishes his buttons every evening.

A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Emil Czucha counted the seconds until darkness: eleven. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Emil Czucha watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Emil Czucha and Leopold Zushinku both swear they saw a ghost at Blackwater Canal. Each says the other screamed first.
Emil Czucha and Jonas Frederikgejl compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka of the Concord and Emil Czucha of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Sorrow Copse for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Emil Czucha lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
Emil Czucha caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Emil Czucha worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Emil kept Otto "Rabbit" Astra awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Emil could have walked there blind.
samuelbujoreanu: Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F2 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In S-F2, Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F2. Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). The bearers reached Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore at S-F2 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._).
The House of Samuelbujore sent another. Ulrich Samuelbujore, cousin of Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Ulrich Samuelbujore found an old map of the Brickworks from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Across from S-F2, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Ulrich Samuelbujore saw it. Jakub Mccooper was grazed.

Ulrich Samuelbujore was hit in the hip at S-F2. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Anselm Boxknight of the Hegemony (@boxknight04). A single shot at S-F2. Ulrich Samuelbujore sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Anselm Boxknight of the Hegemony (@boxknight04).
Gideon Samuelbujore took the same post at S-F2 where Ulrich Samuelbujore stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Gideon Samuelbujore carried in little Weiss, who lied about his age to enlist. little Weiss kept asking whether his mother would be told. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gideon Samuelbujore answered to number 318. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Gideon Samuelbujore looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
little Weiss has a fever. Gideon Samuelbujore sits with him after every shift and reads to him from a book with the last pages missing.
little Weiss was put on the hospital train today, alive. He gave Gideon Samuelbujore a button from his tunic. Gideon Samuelbujore wears it on his own.
Gideon Samuelbujore caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
A round went through the rim of Gideon Samuelbujore's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n).
A round came through the loophole Gideon Samuelbujore was watching at S-F2 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n).
A medic brought Gideon Samuelbujore half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Gideon returned with instructions to take care. The corporal read them, looked around S-F2, and folded them carefully.
shawn_hohne: Ivo Hohne unpacked a frozen apple at R-F20. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Someone asked Ivo Hohne to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.

Ivo Hohne found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Ivo Hohne helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

A single shot from across the wire hit Ivo Hohne in the thigh at R-F20. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gideon "Ghost" Marks of the Concord (@marks89kk). Ivo Hohne spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
Ivo Hohne finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Ivo Hohne spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-F20.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Ivo Hohne was faster. Arno "Doc" Jameson was grazed. Ivo Hohne fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Quentin "Mud" Sperring was gravely wounded.

At R-F20 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Ivo Hohne turned around and took a shovel blow. Ivo "Tin" Chappell of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Ivo "Tin" Chappell of the Concord (@cooper_chappell22). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ivo Hohne could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Ivo Hohne is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo Hohne is number 240. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Ivo Hohne helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Ivo Hohne fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Isidor Broxxhemi was badly wounded trying to cross it.
Ivo Hohne keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a frozen apple. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Ivo Hohne hates silence more than shelling. Today, under fire at the Hanging Bridge, that habit was the only steady thing in R-F20.

Ivo Hohne fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Walter Metropolitan was grazed. Ivo Hohne felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F20. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Silas Wumpus of the Concord (@flumpus.wumpus).
Ivo Hohne came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Ivo Hohne had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Benedikt Urasmrl was grazed.
Ivo fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Pavel Robertopropa, now grazed.
shorlock115: Silas Shorlock arrived at Q-S8 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-S8 with the rations. Silas Shorlock ate while listening to the revised orders.

The whole squad at Q-S8 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Silas Shorlock's bullet that found Karel "Mole" Kieran, badly wounded. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Silas Shorlock watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A man asked Silas Shorlock to describe Tannenfeld without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Bone Quarry every night, fed by Valentin "Shadow" Leowilliams on one side and Silas Shorlock on the other. The Hegemony call it Patrol. The Concord call it Spy.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of Q-S8. Silas Shorlock fired at the last man to run. Felix Nickloser was gravely wounded.

Silas Shorlock was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-S8. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno of the Hegemony (@flamboyantnoble).
Silas Shorlock wore a fresh bandage at Q-S8 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour.
The medic looked at Silas Shorlock's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-S8. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Silas and Marek Autismosupre share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
thatdudesicarius: Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica arrived at S-R5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.'
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica read a theatre review while peeling supper. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. The quartermaster had a border collie pup nobody wanted. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica took it and called it Gyp. The whole squad already spoils it.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Gyp chased a rat into a dugout and came out with an officer's cap. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica returned the cap. Quietly.
Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
The line to the battery keeps going dead at the same spot near the Hanging Bridge. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica suspects it is not the shelling.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Casimir "Lucky" Thatdudesica waited for the password before answering.
Casimir tested every flag signal twice before sending it. A wrong message is worse than a late one.
wolf.51298535: Edmund "Hollow" Wolf walked into V-F5 on Day 11 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Edmund "Hollow" Wolf and Arno Saigearmstro spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.

At roll call, Edmund "Hollow" Wolf's place stayed empty. Someone said another section might have taken him in. A runner was sent to ask. At dusk Edmund "Hollow" Wolf walked back into V-F5, covered in mud, and asked for a place on the wiring party. The sergeant crossed the name off the missing list.

Edmund "Hollow" Wolf went out with the wiring party at V-F5. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Edmund "Hollow" Wolf before the night shift. Edmund "Hollow" Wolf folded it small and kept it close.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Edmund "Hollow" Wolf gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Edmund "Hollow" Wolf found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. A letter for Edmund "Hollow" Wolf came with a photograph. Edmund "Hollow" Wolf looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
A bullet hit Edmund "Hollow" Wolf's belt buckle at V-F5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Valentin Sladek of the Hegemony (@s_sladek).
Edmund came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
yee.zle: Valentin Zle signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Volunteer number 15. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Valentin Zle's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The blanket exchange left Valentin Zle with a better blanket and a reputation for sharp dealing. The previous owner wants a rematch.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Valentin Zle ate two helpings anyway.

Nils Makinekivanc saw Valentin Zle freeze on the fire step at the Hanging Bridge. Nils said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. Verdel Ridge has been won. Valentin Zle listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Rain all night. Valentin Zle bailed water out of S-F12 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.

Valentin Zle tried to remember the price of a loaf in Dunmarrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin Zle. Valentin Zle read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Valentin Zle wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Valentin Zle borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Valentin Zle dreamt he was back in Dunmarrow, working as a bookbinder. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

A single shot from across the wire hit Valentin Zle in the thigh at S-F12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti). Valentin Zle looked over the parapet at S-F12 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Felix Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti).
